🌍 Iran, Iraq discuss expanding educational cooperation

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran and Iraq have the potential to expand cooperation in education, Education Minister Alireza Kazemi said on Monday during a meeting with Iraqi Ambassador to Tehran Yasser Abdul Zahra Al-Hajjaj.

Kazemi said cooperation between the two countries had grown in recent years and called for a review of existing capacities to further develop educational activities.
​
He referred to Iranian schools and educational centers operating in Iraq, including in Karbala, Najaf and Sulaymaniyah, and stressed the need to explore ways to expand their activities.
​
Al-Hajjaj said Baghdad was ready to cooperate in expanding the activities of Iranian schools in Iraq and addressing their needs.
​
There are abundant capacities for increasing cooperation between the two countries, the ambassador said, adding that these capacities should be used to strengthen bilateral ties and cooperation.

🎙 President Pezeshkian nominates Mehrdad Akhlaghi as defense minister

📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian has nominated Mehrdad Akhlaghi Ketabchi to serve as defense minister, submitting the nomination to Parliament for a confidence vote.

Akhlaghi is a senior Defense Ministry official and has previously headed the Aerospace Industries Organization.
​
Sasan Valizadeh, an adviser to the president’s parliamentary affairs deputy, announced the nomination on Monday, saying it was made in accordance with Article 133 of Iran’s Constitution.
​
Parliament is expected to review Akhlaghi’s proposed plans in the relevant committee before holding a confidence vote.
​
If approved, Akhlaghi will succeed Brigadier General Aziz Nasirzadeh, who was martyred in a US-Israeli attack on Iran on Feb. 28.
